questions.prompt: Every street of the city is clean, but yours beats them all. Complete: "My street is ___ street in the city."
questions.explanation: One street above the whole city calls for the superlative: the + clean + est = the cleanest. The form "the cleaner" compares only two streets, "cleanest" forgets the word the, which a superlative always carries, and "more clean" is the form of long adjectives, not of a short one like clean.

questions.prompt: Nadia helps Karim with his homework, and Karim helps Nadia with hers. Which sentence says both things at once?
questions.explanation: The help goes in both directions at the same time, and English says that with each other: They help each other. The sentence "They help them" sends the help to somebody else, "They help the other" names one single person, and each other never takes an -s.

questions.prompt: Of all the houses in the village, one has the largest size. Complete: "This house is ___ in the village."
questions.explanation: The adjective big ends in one short vowel plus one consonant, so the consonant doubles before the ending: the biggest. The spelling "the bigest" forgets that doubling, "the bigger" compares two houses only, and "biggest" drops the word the that every superlative carries.

questions.prompt: A woman drives the school bus every morning. Which sentence names her job correctly?
questions.explanation: The verb drive already ends in e, so the person takes only the letter r: She is a driver. The word "a drive" is the bare verb and names no person, "a driveer" keeps the e and adds the whole ending, and "a drivor" borrows the -or of doctor, which is not the ending of this rule.

questions.prompt: Sarra promises that she will not forget her cat's water. Which sentence is her promise?

options.text: She not will forget the water.
She will not forgets the water.
She doesn't will forget the water.

questions.explanation: The negative future is will not, and its short form is won't: She won't forget the water. The order in "She not will forget" is impossible, "will not forgets" gives the verb an -s that belongs to the present, and "doesn't will forget" borrows the negative of the present, which will never needs.

questions.prompt: Your friend has a new dog. Which sentence is completely correct?

options.text: Take care of you dog, and don't forget its water.
Take care of your dog, and don't forgets its water.
You take care of your dog, and don't forget it water.
Take care of your dog, and don't forget its water.

questions.explanation: Three things must hold together here: the order starts with the bare verb and names nobody, the owner of the dog is you so the word is your, and the owner of the water is the dog, a thing, so the word is its. The sentence "Take care of you dog" uses the subject you where the possessive your is needed, "don't forgets" gives the verb an -s after Don't, and "You take care of" turns the order into a statement while "it water" drops the s of its.
